svg.text: Every wire is drawn. A dot means connected; lines that cross without a dot are not connected. Power and ground go through the two breadboard rails at the bottom.

g.text: C1, C2: 220 µF across the rails, long leg (+) to 5V, stripe (−) to GND
Camera is on the clip-on Sense
board: no wiring. Keep microSD empty.
Colors are a suggestion; any wire works.
